title: La revolución gastronómica: Cebiche, chifa y fusión nikkei
goal: Analyze contemporary Peruvian culinary diplomacy, UNESCO-recognized cebiche, and chifa and nikkei fusions.
grammar: sociología gastronómica peruana, patrimonio inmaterial del cebiche y mestizaje culinario chifa y nikkei

items: Analyze traditional cebiche preparation with lime, chili, and fresh marine catch.
Explore the historical origins of Cantonese chifa and Japanese nikkei innovations.
Deploy culinary arts, fusion gastronomy, and cultural diplomacy vocabulary (cebiche, tiradito, chifa, nikkei).
